issues.legal_issue: A will that directs an heir to be adopted and provides for property to pass after that adoption does not give the named beneficiary an independent gift as persona designata when it contains no direct words of disposition.
material_facts: The claimant sought property under the will as persona designata, apart from his claimed status as an adopted son.
The will directed the widow to adopt the testator’s nephew and to deliver the remaining movable and immovable property to him after he passed his minority.
The will used express words of disposition for property given to the widow and the testator’s mother, but contained no direct words of disposition in favour of the claimant.
The courts found that the claimant had not been adopted.
issues.conclusion: The will did not give the claimant the property as persona designata; his claim under the will failed because the intended transfer was conditional on his adoption, which did not occur.
issues.legal_principle: The testator’s intention must be determined from the will’s language and the surrounding circumstances, distinguishing a description of the recipient from the reason, motive, or condition for the gift. The Court relied on Fanindra Deb Raikat v. Rajeswar Dass, 12 I.A. 72, where the assumed adoption was the reason and condition of the gift, and distinguished Nidhoomoni Debya v. Saroda Pershad Mookerjee, 3 I.A. 253, where the will contained an express gift to the designated person that was not dependent on the stated ceremonies.

rule.if: will_construction_claim and will_directs_adoption and property_transfer_follows_adoption and direct_disposition_absent and adoption_not_performed

predicates.will_construction_claim: A claimant seeks property under a will as a named beneficiary, apart from any claim based on legal status.
predicates.will_directs_adoption: The will directs another person to adopt the named beneficiary.
predicates.property_transfer_follows_adoption: The will provides for property to pass to the beneficiary after the adoption or after a stage dependent on that adoption.
predicates.direct_disposition_absent: The will contains no direct words giving or devising the property to the named beneficiary.
predicates.adoption_not_performed: The directed adoption of the named beneficiary did not occur.

issues.definition: When a claimant seeks property under a will as a named beneficiary, the will directs adoption, property transfer follows that adoption, no direct disposition is made, and the adoption does not occur, the claimant has no independent entitlement to the property under the will.
